name: General Graardor
dataSource: Monster statistics: OSRS Wiki via bundled monsters.json. Strategy notes: OSRS Wiki General Graardor/Strategies.
validationNotes: DPS against General Graardor is covered by reference validation. The three sergeants are not included in the DPS figures, and group damage sharing is not modelled: group mode only changes the inventory template.

requirements.text: 40 Bandos kill count (less with the relevant diary) and a hammer are needed to enter the room

warnings: Wear at least one Bandos item (and ideally other god items) to avoid aggression in the main dungeon; god protection is not scored by the optimiser.
Sergeant kills are not included in the DPS estimate.

strategies.name: Melee (tank)
strategies.description: Melee in the room, absorbing Graardor's attacks.

strategies.name: Ranged (kiting)
strategies.description: Ranged while moving between marked tiles so Graardor rarely reaches melee range. Pair with one of the General Graardor tile packs.
